fullDescription: A light, graph-paper dev-tool pricing page pairing 3 subscription tiers with a row of volume-discounted one-time credit packs, all in a single electric-cyan accent.
prompt:
## Resumo
A frameless, responsive SaaS pricing page for an AI design tool, built on a light off-white canvas with a faint 44px graph-paper grid and an electric-cyan accent system. It pairs a 3-tier subscription card row (with a highlighted 'Most popular' middle card and a monthly/yearly toggle) with a distinct 5-step one-time credit-pack row and a usage-cost explainer strip, then an accordion FAQ and CTA. The signature move is the dual pricing model on one page: recurring tiers up top, scaling pay-as-you-go credit packs below.

## Estilo Visual
Use a light, airy palette on an off-white app background (#f7fbfc) with a near-black 'ink' for text and UI (#0c1418, used at reduced opacities like ink/65, ink/55 for secondary text and ink/[.07]-ink/12 for hairline borders). The single accent is a cyan ramp: cyan-50 #ecfdff, cyan-100 #cff8fe, cyan-200 #a5eefd, cyan-300 #67dffa, cyan-400 #22c6ec, cyan-500 #06a8cf, cyan-600 #0788ae, cyan-700 #0d6c8d, cyan-800 #155873, cyan-900 #164a62; a neutral slate-50 #f8fafb fills muted card interiors. Primary buttons and highlight badges use a left-to-right cyan-700->cyan-800 gradient; the brand logo mark and Pro tier icon use a cyan-400->cyan-600 top-left-to-bottom-right gradient. Apply a custom 'glow' shadow on accent elements (0 18px 50px -16px rgba(6,168,207,.55)) and soft layered card shadows (rest: 0 1px 2px rgba(12,20,24,.04), 0 8px 28px -12px rgba(12,20,24,.10); hover: deeper cyan-tinted lift). Behind the hero and final CTA, paint a graph-paper grid: a top-center radial cyan tint (radial-gradient 120% 120% at 50% -10%, rgba(6,168,207,.10)) over 1px ink/[.035] lines at 44px x 44px. Typography: headings/display and prices in Space Grotesk (700) with tight tracking (about -0.02em on the h1); body, labels and nav in Inter (400-600); prices and credit numbers use tabular-nums. Generous radii (rounded-lg/xl/2xl), pill-shaped toggles and badges, antialiased text. Gradient-clip the hero accent word in cyan-500->cyan-700.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (z-50) with a translucent white background (white/80) and backdrop-blur and a hairline bottom border. Inside a 1180px max centered row at h-16: left cluster is the brand (8x8 rounded cyan-400->cyan-600 gradient square with a white sparkle icon + 'Promptscape' wordmark in Space Grotesk 700) followed by inline text links (Library, Canvas, Pricing [active, cyan-700], Docs) that get a cyan-50 hover background. Right cluster: a ghost 'Sign in' link and a solid near-black 'Start free' pill button with a right-arrow that nudges on hover. Below md, the nav links collapse into a hamburger that toggles a full-width blurred mobile menu.

### Hero / headline
Centered hero over the graph-paper grid background. Top: a pill badge with a pinging cyan dot and small-caps copy 'Credits never expire on top-up packs'. Then a large Space Grotesk 700 headline (40px mobile -> 58px desktop, leading-[1.05]) reading 'Pay for what you actually generate.' with 'generate' as a cyan-500->cyan-700 gradient-clipped word. A muted subhead (max-w-xl, ink/60) explains top-up vs subscribe. Below it, a centered billing toggle (see components) and a horizontal trust strip of three items separated by thin vertical dividers: '56k designers building', 'No card to start', 'Cancel anytime', each with a small cyan phosphor icon.

### Subscription tiers (the primary pricing layout)
A responsive pricing grid: 3 columns on lg, 2 on md, 1 on mobile (gap-5). Three rounded-2xl white cards, each: an icon chip + tier name (Space Grotesk 700) row, a one-line description, a big price (Space Grotesk 700, 44px, tabular-nums) with a '/period' suffix, a cyan-700 credits-per-month line, a full-width CTA button, then a check-list of features (cyan check icons). Card 1 'Starter' $0/forever, 120 credits/mo, ghost 'Get started' button. Card 2 'Pro' is the highlight: 2px cyan-400 border, raised (lg:-mt-3 lg:mb-3), an absolute '-top' centered 'MOST POPULAR' gradient pill badge, gradient cyan icon chip, $24/mo (data toggles to $19 yearly), 2,500 credits, a glowing cyan-700->cyan-800 'Start 7-day trial' button. Card 3 'Studio' $79/mo, 10,000 shared credits, near-black icon chip, ghost 'Talk to sales'. Cards lift on hover. A centered fine-print line under the grid: 'All plans include unused-credit rollover for 60 days. Cancel anytime.'

### Credit packs band (one-time top-ups)
A full-bleed white band with top/bottom hairline borders and a centered intro: a cyan ring-bordered 'One-time top-ups' pill, an h2 'Need more credits?' (Space Grotesk 700, up to 38px), and a muted subhead. Below, a 5-up pack grid (5 cols on lg, 3 on sm, 2 on mobile, gap-4). Each pack is a small centered rounded-2xl card on slate-50/60 that turns white with a cyan border on hover, showing: big credit count (Space Grotesk 700 tabular-nums), uppercase 'CREDITS' label, a short divider rule, the pack price, a per-credit unit price, a savings label (cyan-700 'save X%' or 'base rate'), and a small 'Buy' button. The 3rd pack ('6,000 / $54 / save 25%') is the 'Best value' highlight: 2px cyan border, glow shadow, gradient 'Buy' button, an absolute top badge, and spans 2 columns on mobile. Per-credit price decreases as packs scale ($0.012 down to $0.007).

### Usage cost strip
Directly under the packs, a single dark (near-black ink background) rounded-2xl strip that stacks vertically on mobile and goes horizontal on sm, listing three usage examples with cyan-300 icons and white/70 labels: '1 UI mockup ~ 4 credits', '1 component set ~ 10 credits', '1 full design ~ 25 credits', divided by thin white/15 vertical rules.

### Feature strip
A 4-up grid (4 cols lg, 2 sm, 1 mobile) of small white rounded-2xl cards with soft shadow, each: a 26px cyan icon, a Space Grotesk 700 16px title, and a short muted description. The four: Infinite canvas, Agent skill (drive from Claude Code / Cursor), Real export (React / HTML / Figma), Zero lock-in.

### FAQ
A narrow centered column (max-w-760px) with a centered h2 'Frequently asked questions' and a native <details>/<summary> accordion list separated by hairline dividers. Each summary is a 600-weight question with a cyan caret that rotates 180deg when open (first item open by default). Five Q&As covering: what a credit is, whether top-up credits expire, mixing subscription + packs, what happens on cancel (warm, friendly 'ping us and we'll sort it together' voice), and the free way to try.

### CTA band + footer
A closing CTA section on the same graph-paper grid background: centered h2 'Your next design is a prompt away.', a muted subhead, and two centered buttons (a glowing cyan-700->cyan-800 'Start designing free' primary + a ghost 'View packs' secondary) that stack on mobile and sit side-by-side on sm. Footer: a white band with top hairline, holding the brand mark + wordmark on the left, a wrap of muted text links (Library, Pricing, Docs, Changelog) centered, and a small copyright on the right; it stacks vertically on mobile.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Monthly / Yearly billing toggle — A pill-shaped segmented control in the hero that switches all tier prices between monthly and yearly rates.
Build a rounded-full bordered white toggle (with card shadow, p-1) containing two pill buttons: 'Monthly' and 'Yearly'. The Yearly button carries a small cyan-100 '-20%' badge. The active button fills near-black with white text; inactive is muted ink. Clicking swaps each price element's text via data attributes (monthly vs yearly value, e.g. Pro $24 -> $19) and updates the period suffix from '/month' to '/mo, billed yearly'.

### Highlighted 'Most popular' tier card — The center subscription card, visually promoted above its neighbors.
Give the recommended tier a 2px cyan-400 border, a vertical lift on large screens (negative top margin), a glow shadow, a gradient cyan icon chip, and an absolutely-positioned centered pill badge bleeding above the top edge ('MOST POPULAR', uppercase, gradient cyan-700->cyan-800, white text). Its CTA is the only filled gradient+glow button among the tiers.

### Scaling credit-pack cards with per-credit math — A row of one-time purchase packs where the unit price drops as volume rises.
Render packs as compact centered cards showing credit quantity, total price, computed per-credit price, and a savings badge. As packs increase in size, the per-credit price decreases ($0.012 -> $0.0108 -> $0.009 -> $0.008 -> $0.007) and the savings label grows (base rate -> save 10/25/33/42%). Highlight one 'Best value' pack with a cyan border, glow, top badge and gradient Buy button; let it span two columns at the smallest breakpoint.

### Graph-paper hero/CTA background — A subtle technical grid backdrop used behind the hero and final CTA bands.
Layer a CSS background combining a top-center cyan radial tint (rgba(6,168,207,.10)) over two repeating 1px ink-at-3.5% gridlines at 44px x 44px to create faint graph paper, evoking a design canvas.

### Pinging live badge — Small animated status dot in the hero announcement pill.
A pill badge with a cyan dot that uses a duplicated absolutely-positioned element with an animate-ping ring over a solid cyan-500 core, paired with concise feature copy.

## Notas Especiais
Frameless, fully responsive single page, not a fixed device mock: content is centered at max-w-1180px and every grid reflows by breakpoint (tiers 3->2->1, packs 5->3->2, features 4->2->1). The defining structural idea is showing TWO pricing models on one page: recurring subscription tiers plus volume-discounted one-time credit packs, glued together by a credits mental model and a usage-cost explainer. Built with Tailwind (CDN) + Space Grotesk/Inter via Google Fonts + Iconify (Phosphor 'ph:' icon set). Interactivity is vanilla JS: the billing toggle rewrites prices/periods from data-m/data-y attributes, and a hamburger toggles the mobile menu. Keep the voice warm and human in microcopy (e.g. the cancel FAQ). When recreating, preserve the single-cyan-accent restraint on a light paper background, the tabular-num prices, and the glow accents on highlighted elements.
